raw_response:
I've farmed this land 45 years, so I don't think too hard about it. I do what my neighbors do and what worked last year. Let me think through my 7 mu.

All 7 mu is cotton this year, same as last year. My cropping system is cotton — one crop a year, plant in April, pick in October. I tried wheat-cotton double cropping years back but the wheat stubble made the cotton late, so I stopped. I grow a little maize and wheat on small patches near the house for family eating, but on my main 7 mu it's all cotton.

Seeds: I buy the Bt cotton seed from the agri-store in town. Everyone uses it now because the bollworm doesn't kill it like before. Costs about 80 yuan a bag, I need 2 bags for 7 mu. I don't plant the old seed anymore — nobody does.

Fertilizer: Before planting I put down compound fertilizer 15-15-15, about 50 kg per mu as base. That's one bag per mu, 140 yuan a bag. Then when cotton starts flowering I topdress urea, maybe 25 kg per mu. So my nitrogen comes to about 7.5 from compound plus 11.5 from urea, call it around 19 kg/mu N. Phosphorus and potassium mostly from the compound, about 7.5 kg each. This is what I always do. Too little and the bolls are small; too much and the plant grows tall with few bolls. My father taught me: feed the cotton but don't spoil it.

Water: I have my own well, so I water when the sky doesn't. Usually 3 times — once after planting if dry, once at flowering, once when bolls are filling. If it rains good I skip some.

Spray: Cotton needs lots of spray. Aphids in early summer, spider mites, bollworm (still some even with Bt seed), plant bug. I spray maybe 7-8 times across the season. This is the biggest cost after fertilizer — maybe 400 yuan total on pesticide for 7 mu.

Tillage: I plough in autumn after pulling stalks, then rotary in spring before planting. I pay the tractor man 50 yuan per mu for ploughing.

Yield: Good year I get 300 kg seed cotton per mu, bad year 220. I plan for 280.
